purpose: Ed25519 public keys for ThoughtProof Sentinel M1 signed canonical export (thoughtproof.sentinel.export.v1). Receivers must pin this URL and kid out-of-band; the document alone is not a trust root.

keys.usage: Sign sentinel.verdict.canonical.v1 export envelopes (M1). Not EAS attester. Not X-Sentinel-Key.

export.canonicalDigest: 0x || sha256(UTF-8(transported canonical JCS string)) — do not re-JCS an object
export.signature: Ed25519 detached over signedInput; wire encoding 0x + lowercase hex (64 bytes)

rotation: Publish new kid before first use.
Never delete old keys from this document — set notAfter (and status=retired) instead.
Receivers pin URL + kid set out-of-band.
notes: M1 vector / pilot key — rotate for production with a new kid; keep this kid listed with notAfter after cutover.
Private key is never published. Production signing uses env SENTINEL_EXPORT_PRIVATE_KEY + SENTINEL_EXPORT_KEY_ID.
EAS attester and API keys are different trust roots and must not be substituted for this export key.
